rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a quality standard, benchmark, or agreed requirement.

example.english: The service standard at this restaurant is very high.
example.traditional: 呢間餐廳嘅服務標準好高。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 ge3 fuk6 mou6 biu1 zeon2 hou2 gou1

rows.note: Use this for the level of quality or attainment, rather than a formal benchmark or rule.

example.english: The standard of your cooking is much higher now.
example.traditional: 你而家煮餸嘅水平高咗好多。
example.jyutping: nei5 ji4 gaa1 zyu2 sung3 ge3 seoi2 ping4 gou1 zo2 hou2 do1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something within the accepted norm or supplied in the default form.

example.english: This is the standard version, so there’s no need to pay extra.
example.traditional: 呢個係標準版本，唔使另外加錢。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 hai6 biu1 zeon2 baan2 bun2 m4 sai2 ling6 ngoi6 gaa1 cin2

rows.note: Use this when the quality is adequate because it meets the relevant minimum requirements.

example.english: The phone is old, but its quality is still standard enough for everyday use.
example.traditional: 呢部電話舊係舊，但係質素仲算合格。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 din6 waa2 gau6 hai6 gau6 daan6 hai6 zat1 sou3 zung6 syun3 hap6 gaak3

rows.note: Use this for works or authors recognized as classic and exemplary rather than merely acceptable.

example.english: This book is a standard classic recognized by the literary world.
example.traditional: 呢本書係文學界公認嘅經典。
example.jyutping: ni1 bun2 syu1 hai6 man4 hok6 gaai3 gung1 jan6 ge3 ging1 din2

rows.note: Use this for a source, author, or work recognized as authoritative.

example.english: This book is the standard authority on this subject.
example.traditional: 呢本書係研究呢個題目嘅權威。
example.jyutping: ni1 bun2 syu1 hai6 jin4 gau3 ni1 go3 tai4 muk6 ge3 kyun4 wai1

rows.note: Use this when the standard means an imposed rule or requirement, especially one set by an authority.

example.english: The new government standard requires all restaurants to install fire extinguishers.
example.traditional: 政府嘅新規定要求所有餐廳都要加裝滅火筒。
example.jyutping: zing3 fu2 ge3 san1 kwai1 ding6 jiu3 kau4 so2 jau5 caan1 teng1 dou1 jiu3 gaa1 zong1 mit6 fo2 tung4
